source.rule: An RBDNonCriticalSet, linked by MaterielOperationalModes.NCID, contains listed materiel. Manual p453 says its failed items do not cause system down time; p454 defines QTYNC as the quantity of an MID in that set.

configuration.parent: Accepted G09.var01: BASIC h8/h32 explicit two-position series, PAR h20 explicit active parallel. Same POS-B fault h8.62763 is critical and aborts BASIC in the parent.
configuration.child: Add RBDNonCriticalSet G09-NC-B and RBDNonCriticalSetItems POS-B QTYNC1 USERT1; assign NCID only to TEACH-AIR-01/G09-SER-OPS; change description. Both RBDs, mission mappings/schedule, physical B/A failure modes, CM, seed1, replication1 and horizon36 fixed.

pre_run_hypotheses: Native conversion accepts the series mode with both RBID and NCID, with zero errors and reviewed diagnostics and exact populated-table import/export roundtrip.

The BASIC h8 POS-B fault remains a physical failure but is noncritical, and the h8 BASIC mission does not abort; later event times and outcomes are inspected rather than assumed to match the accepted parent.
Report reconciles all observed failures/repairs and 72 System/Stock bins, no stock movement, and terminal readiness.
native_acceptance: Unique guarded session-0 SSH run with host-wide mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration, frozen source/control fingerprints and raw SHA-256 seals.
Exact populated-table roundtrip, zero converter errors, reviewed warnings, nonempty SXO/event log/report and 72-bin System/Stock reconciliation.
Independent read-only replay compares the h8 fault and mission outcome with accepted explicit-series parent; no claim that native event log prints NCID.
diagnostic_gate: If the h8 B fault is absent, critical, or the mission aborts from it, retain as diagnostic and revise with a new version/run ID; do not change this frozen hypothesis.
limits: One POS-B materiel position, QTYNC1 and USERT1 in one selected system mode, one aircraft and one seed/replication. QTYNC greater than one, overlapping sets and other G09.var03 boundaries remain open.
NCID selection is frozen-source/roundtrip based because the native event log may not print the set name. No GUI drawing, population reliability or cross-engine claim.
